text:
maya: Heads-up — FedHealth security review scheduled Tue 11am PST. They want: KMS envelope proof, RBAC mapping export, and a set of audit logs covering key ops + tenant access for last 90 days. Need a short evidence checklist we can hand them by Fri EOD.

aj: Do we have a standard export for that or is this a custom pull? Also clarifying: FedHealth is in AWS GovCloud — cross-account exports might need a different flow.

samir: We have an export path. For GovCloud tenant logs we currently support: CloudTrail -> S3 (gov) -> gov-s3-replication -> central-security (non-gov) only with manual approvals. For immediate ask, we can produce a signed ndjson export from the gov S3 bucket.

elaine: Flag — these logs are likely to contain PHI. We need to redact PII/PHI before sharing. Customer asked for full request/response bodies for KMS calls? we should avoid sharing sensitive plaintext.

security-bot: Data classification detected: repository=gov-logs, tag=PHI, level=high. Follow evidence-sharing runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/evidence-share

maya: Good points. Let's split: aj — generate export & signed manifest. samir — build redaction + signing tool. elaine — sign off on what can be redacted (PHI rules). devops — confirm network/replication constraints for GovCloud copy. Aim: packaged archive + manifest + md summary.

aj: Will do. Quick Q — what format for manifest? simple yaml with sha256 sums?

samir: Yes, manifest.yaml with SHA256 per file + timestamp + tool version. We should GPG-sign the manifest. Example manifest snippet:

```
manifest_version: 1
created_at: 2024-11-12T16:00:00Z
files:
  - path: /exports/fedhealth/kms-audit-2024-08-01_2024-11-01.ndjson.gz
    sha256: 3b7a8c...\n```

samir: For logs, export fields we provide: ["event_time","principal","tenant_id","key_id","action","request_id","src_ip","user_agent","status","raw_request_ref"]. We should strip raw_request_ref to a pointer (e.g., s3://gov-logs/... ) and redact any plaintext in request/response.

elaine: Accepted. Redaction rules: remove or tokenise PHI (names, SSNs, DOB), redact request/response bodies unless explicitly required and authorized. Provide sample redaction policy in the package.

devops: GovCloud note — we cannot auto-replicate to central until an approvals ticket and a cross-account role is created. For a one-off export, I can grant aj temporary read-only S3 role scoped to the bucket and path and we can run the export with auditing enabled. ETA for role: 2 hours once I have justification.

aj: I'll wait for role. Meanwhile I'm drafting the export command. Prototype: 

```
./scripts/export_kms_audit.sh \
  --bucket s3://gov-logs/fedhealth/kms/ \
  --since 2024-08-01 \
  --until 2024-11-01 \
  --format ndjson \
  --compress gz \
  --out /tmp/fedhealth-export/
```

aj: After export we'll run the redaction tool and then sign the manifest.

maya: Also include an IR artifacts checklist: chain-of-custody statement, signed-by list (who ran export), and a note of any skipped events due to retention gaps. Customers (esp regulated ones) care about missing data.

samir: For redaction tool I'm going to use jq + regex tokenisers and a small mapping table to pseudonymize principal IDs. Example jq filter: 

```
jq 'del(.raw_request_body) | .principal |= sub("^user:[^@]+@"; "user:REDACTED@")' input.ndjson
```

samir: We'll also provide a small schema doc describing each field and the redaction approach.

elaine: For KMS envelope proof they specifically asked for key usage logs and an HSM attestation (or KMS CloudHSM evidence). Do we have an attestation blob?

samir: We have CloudHSM attestation reports and we can include the signed attestation.pdf from the HSM vendor. For AWS-managed KMS keys in gov, we can include key policy exports + admin role mappings. Example key policy snippet I can attach: 

```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "EnableAdmins",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-kms-admins"},
      "Action": "kms:*",
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```

devops: FYI cross-account role name will be: gov-export-role@redwood. I'll create it in GovCloud with tight scoping.

maya: Timeline: role + export run today. samir finish redaction + manifest by Thu morning. elaine final sign-off Thu afternoon. Package to customer Fri EOD. If anyone can't meet, flag now.

aj: I can run export today once role exists.

samir: I can deliver redaction tool Thu morning.

elaine: I can review Thu afternoon.

security-bot: Action items created: #SEC-5421 (export request), #SEC-5422 (redaction + manifest), #SEC-5423 (attestation attach).

maya: Thanks — please ping here when you upload artifacts. Also add short md with "what we redacted and why" for audit transparency. :thumbsup:

aj: Uploaded initial export to s3://redwood-temp/fedhealth-review/kms-audit-raw/ — awaiting role cleanup. Link: https://s3-gov.aws/redwood-temp/fedhealth-review/kms-audit-raw/

samir: Running redaction now. I'll post ETA in 30m.

elain: small correction: "elaine" signing off later (typo)

maya: noted, thanks everyone.
